name: Install Script
description: Fetch and execute an install script from a URL.

scriptURL.description: URL of the Bash-compatible install script to execute. Must not be empty.

scriptArgs.description: Dynamically evaluated, space-separated Bash word list of arguments passed to the install script.

envVars.description: Dynamically evaluated, space-separated Bash word list of NAME=VALUE environment variable assignments for the install script.
